elements.name: SFAError
elements.docstring: Base error for SFA. Messages always include a path and an actionable hint.

elements.name: find_project_root

parameters.name: start
parameters.default: None

elements.docstring:
Walk upward from *start* (defaults to cwd) until a directory containing
    a ``.sfa/`` metadata dir or a ``sfa.yml`` config is found.

    Raises SFAError with an actionable hint when not found.

elements.name: load_config

parameters.name: root
parameters.default: None

elements.docstring:
Load and merge ``sfa.yml`` with defaults. Returns a fully-populated dict.

    Missing optional sections fall back to DEFAULT_CONFIG.

elements.name: infer_contract
elements.docstring:
Build a contract dict from *entry_element* (an elements.json record).

    The contract has keys: ``module``, ``version_hash``, ``input_schema``,
    ``output_schema``, ``natural_summary``.

elements.name: write_contract
elements.docstring:
Write *contract* to ``.sfa/modules/{module_id}/contract.json``.

    Returns the absolute path written.

elements.name: write_summary
elements.docstring: Write *summary* to ``.sfa/modules/{module_id}/summary.md``.

elements.name: contract_rel_path
elements.docstring: Return the project-root-relative posix path for a module's contract.

elements.name: summary_rel_path
elements.docstring: Return the project-root-relative posix path for a module's summary.

elements.name: _annotation_to_schema
elements.docstring: Map a raw Python annotation string to a JSON-Schema fragment.

elements.name: _split_top_level
elements.docstring: Split *s* on *delim* respecting ``[]`` / ``()`` nesting.

elements.name: _find_top_bracket
elements.docstring: Return the index of the first top-level ``[`` in *s*, or None.

elements.name: extract

parameters.name: root
parameters.default: None

elements.docstring: Run extraction and write ``.sfa/elements.json``. Returns the document.

elements.name: init_project

parameters.name: target
parameters.default: None

parameters.name: force
parameters.default: False

elements.docstring:
Create the ``.sfa/`` structure and ``sfa.yml`` template under *target*.

    Idempotent: existing files are never overwritten unless ``force`` is set.
    Returns the project root path.

elements.name: add_module

parameters.name: validation
parameters.default: None

elements.docstring:
Create an atomic module from an entry element.

    1. Load elements.json, resolve *entry* to an element.
    2. Detect owned elements via tree-sitter call analysis.
    3. Infer and persist contract.json + summary.md.
    4. Append module to pipeline.yml.

    Returns the module dict.

elements.name: remove_module
elements.docstring:
Remove a module and cascade-delete pipes referencing it.

    Returns ``(removed_module, removed_pipes)``.

elements.name: list_modules
elements.docstring: Return all modules from pipeline.yml.

elements.name: _detect_owned_elements
elements.docstring:
Determine which elements are owned by the module.

    The entry element is always owned.  Additionally:
    * If the entry is a method, all sibling methods of the same class are owned.
    * Any element called from within the entry's body (in the same file) is owned.

elements.name: _extract_calls_from_body
elements.docstring:
Parse the entry element's source file and collect call targets.

    Returns a list of ``(call_kind, name)`` where *call_kind* is
    ``"simple"`` (bare ``foo()``) or ``"self_method"`` (``self.bar()``).

elements.name: _find_function_node
elements.docstring: Locate the ``function_definition`` node matching *name* and *line_start*.

elements.name: _collect_calls
elements.docstring: Recursively collect call targets from *node*.

elements.name: add_pipe

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.default: None

elements.docstring:
Create a pipe from *source* to *target*.

    Validates that both modules exist, there is no duplicate, and
    source != target.  The pipe's *parent* is the common parent of
    the two endpoints (or ``None`` when they differ).

elements.name: remove_pipe
elements.docstring: Remove pipe *pipe_id* from pipeline.yml.

elements.name: list_pipes
elements.docstring: Return all pipes from pipeline.yml.

elements.name: load_pipeline
elements.docstring:
Load ``pipeline.yml``.  Returns ``{"modules": [...], "pipes": [...]}``.

    Handles a missing file or the legacy empty ``modules: []\\npipes: []``
    format gracefully.

elements.name: save_pipeline
elements.docstring: Write *data* back to ``pipeline.yml``.

elements.name: add_module
elements.docstring: Append *module* to pipeline.yml.  Raises on duplicate ID.

elements.name: remove_module
elements.docstring: Remove module *module_id* from pipeline.yml (no pipe cascade).

elements.name: add_pipe
elements.docstring: Append *pipe* to pipeline.yml.  Raises on duplicate source-target pair.

elements.name: remove_pipes_referencing
elements.docstring:
Remove every pipe whose *source* or *target* is *module_id*.

    Returns the removed pipes (may be empty).

elements.name: group_modules
elements.docstring:
Pack *child_ids* into a new composite module.

    Returns the created composite dict.

elements.name: ungroup_composite
elements.docstring:
Remove composite *composite_id*, promoting its children to its parent.

    Returns ``(composite_dict, child_ids)``.

elements.name: drill_composite
elements.docstring: Return ``(child_modules, internal_pipes)`` for *composite_id*.

elements.name: sanitize_id
elements.docstring:
Convert a display *name* to a valid module ID slug.

    Unicode word characters (including CJK) are preserved; all other
    characters become ``_``. A leading digit is prefixed with ``m_``.

elements.name: _check_not_descendant
elements.docstring: Ensure *composite_id* is not among *child_ids* or their descendants.
